groupDesign.splitRule: All four paraphrase/representation variants for a semantic concept stay in the same split.

curriculumPurpose: Level A teaches exact strict-JSON serialization of already-specified plan fields.
Level B teaches binding supplied semantic fields into the strict plan schema.
Level C teaches full request-to-plan semantic composition on concepts not used in P2-31 development.
approvalMeaning: Owner review approves only the authored curriculum bytes and preparation work. It does not authorize optimizer updates.
